title: Import System Internals: Finders and Loaders
summary: What import really does: the sys.modules cache, finders on sys.meta_path, specs, loaders, packages and relative imports, and reload. Build a finder that serves modules and packages from a dict, installs and uninstalls cleanly, and supports reload, instead of pushing fake modules into sys.modules.

resources.label: PEP 451: A ModuleSpec Type for the Import System
